description.value:
An invisible, immobile prison of solid energy springs up around an area you choose within range, shaped either as a cage of thin bars (up to 20 feet per side) or a solid box that blocks matter and powers alike (up to 10 feet per side). A creature entirely within the chosen area when you cast the power is trapped inside; a creature only partly within the area, or too large to fit, is instead pushed outside it.

A trapped creature cannot leave by unenhanced means. If it tries to teleport out, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw to do so; on a failure, it remains trapped and wastes the attempt.

This power cannot be dispelled.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 7
